subject: CS handoff: ops playbook, tracing hooks & alert routing for FinSight
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Green <ava.green@finsight.com>; Samir Ahmed <samir.ahmed@finsight.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + ops playbook draft & next steps

Hi Ava & Samir —

Great speaking yesterday. Attached is a working draft of the ops playbook we discussed: a concise set of dashboards, tracing hook placements, error taxonomy, and alert routing we recommend for FinSight's Redwood deployment. The file is a v0.3 which focuses on the three onboarding success criteria we agreed on:

- Fast incident detection for query latency regressions
- Clear ownership for model degradation alerts
- Low-noise alerting during normal traffic spikes

What you'll find in the attachment: a proposed dashboard layout (token-level latency, per-model p50/p95/p99, tail-kv hit rate), suggested tracing hook points (ingest, tokenize, model-infer, postprocess), a starter error taxonomy, and an alert-routing matrix mapping alerts to owner groups (app, infra, CS).

Next steps: Can you confirm by Tue (4/14) which teams at FinSight should be primary/secondary owners for alerts? Once I have that, Dev will draft the tracing snippets and Diego will seed the runbook templates.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Wed to walk through the dashboards and verify access.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachments: ops_playbook_v0.3.pdf

From: Ava Green <ava.green@finsight.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Ahmed <samir.ahmed@finsight.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + ops playbook draft & next steps

Thanks Grace — this looks promising. Quick answers:

- Primary owner for model degradation alerts: Platform Team (Samir)
- Secondary owner: Data Engineering
- Primary owner for latency alerts: App SRE (Leah Park)
- Secondary: FinSight Support (rotating pager)

Samir and I will join the Wed sync. Two asks before then:
1) Can you add an example alert threshold for p95 latency (we run at ~120ms p95 baseline)
2) Include a short blameless postmortem checklist in the runbook template

Appreciate it — attaching internal doc showing our current incident roles for reference.

Best,
Ava
Ava Green | Head of Product Operations, FinSight
ava.green@finsight.com
Attachment: finsight_incident_roles.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + ops playbook draft & next steps

Looping in technical owners — I pulled the playbook and sketched the tracing-hook snippets and an initial alert matrix. Highlights:

- Suggested p95 alert threshold: baseline + 40ms (so ~160ms p95) until we have 24h of production telemetry, then tighten.
- Tracing hook placements: ingress (request id), tokenizer.start/end, model.forward.start/end, postprocess.start/end — each emits span with token_count and kv_hit boolean.
- KV cache miss spikes should be instrumented as a separate metric and has its own page on the dashboard.

I'll attach the snippets (tracing-hook-snippets.txt) and an alert-routing CSV for Marissa to review. Diego — can you draft two runbook templates:
1) Latency spike (with triage checklist and escalation steps)
2) Model quality regression (eval plan + rollback steps)

Thanks — I'll be on the Wed sync and will demo the tracing spans in a short live session.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: tracing-hook-snippets.txt, alert-routing-matrix.csv

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Intro + ops playbook draft & next steps

Drafted runbooks and pushed to the Google Drive link. Key callouts I put in the templates:

- Playbook "Latency spike": immediate checks (ingress QPS, upstream model queue depth, KV cache hit-rate), quick mitigations (warm-up smaller batch, force route to lower-latency model variant), and owners + contact matrix.
- Playbook "Model quality regression": includes a sample eval suite command, steps to run batch eval on staging, a rollback policy that prefers "gradual weight swap" if available, and a hard rollback to previous pinned version.
- Blameless postmortem checklist included as a separate checklist PDF.

Marissa — can you confirm the on-call contact format we want in the runbooks (pagerduty IDs vs emails)? Ava/Samir, can you confirm who will receive automated CS-level notifications vs SRE-level ones?

Diego Fernandez
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Green <ava.green@finsight.com>, Samir Ahmed <samir.ahmed@finsight.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized tasks before Wed sync + access checklist

Hi Ava & Samir —

Thanks for the ownership details earlier this week. Quick summary of what we've completed and what we need from FinSight before the Wed sync (04/21):

Completed by Redwood:
- v0.3 ops playbook (attached) with dashboard wireframes and alert-routing proposals
- Tracing hook snippets and span naming conventions (attached)
- Two runbook templates (latency spike, model regression) + blameless checklist

Action items for FinSight before Wed:
- Confirm primary/secondary owners in writing (reply here) — we have Platform Team (Samir) and App SRE as primary for latency
- Provide a single contact list for automated alerts (emails or PD IDs) — we need this to populate runbooks
- Grant read access to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/finSight-onboarding/ops-playbook

Meeting details: Wed 04/21 10:00am PT — Zoom invite sent separately. We'll demo the tracing spans, walk through dashboard mockups, and align on thresholds.

If anything urgent, flag here. Otherwise we will take your confirmations as input and lock v0.4 of the playbook next Tuesday.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachments: ops_playbook_v0.3.pdf, tracing-hook-snippets.txt, alert-routing-matrix.csv
